blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Filipino consumers and businesses remained pessimistic in the third quarter, but their outlook brightened sharply as they anticipated higher incomes, stronger demand and improved profits, according to the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP).
